research_question: On four previously observed goal-aware baseline failures with no discovered Minimal-B outcome, does repeatable same-session target-state replay improve paired EnvBench Official Pass@1 over a fresh goal-aware free Agent using the same model?

rule: Start from committed goal-aware baseline Official failures recorded before this study.
Exclude cases with a discovered current Minimal-B F+O+R trajectory or outcome.
Retain every remaining case found by the committed evidence audit: meerkat, pysnmp, openqasm, and stopstalk-deployment.
Do not rank by expected treatment repairability, repository contents, or any new A/B outcome.
selection.interpretation: This is a targeted consumed-development repair study, not a held-out success-rate or generalization estimate.

A_FO.description: One unrestricted continuous Agent session with ordinary execution feedback and the complete public goal; no target-state replay action.

B_FOR.description: The same session and public goal plus Agent-invoked repeatable target-state replay. Replay failures return to the same session, and delivery requires the replay-passing program.

shared: DeepInfra through OpenRouter with fallbacks disabled
complete public goal and initial repository information
shared minimal evaluator and repository integrity boundary
Spark Linux ARM64 execution from one committed clean Git checkout
broad request, token, wall-time, and provider-retry runaway limits

execution.matching: Fresh A and B rollouts request the same seed within each pair; provider execution remains stochastic.
execution.order: Alternate A-first and B-first by case.
execution.source_requirement: Launch both lanes from the same clean committed EnvSolve-pro checkout so run manifests can establish source eligibility.

endpoints.primary: Paired EnvBench Official Pass@1 over scientifically eligible pairs, with valid non-submission counted as failure.
endpoints.failure_analysis: Assign the earliest decisive Observation, Constraint, or Operation cause; censor infrastructure and protocol failures.
endpoints.resources: Report requests, tokens, generation time, Official time, network traffic when available, and storage without using them as success thresholds.

analysis.statistics: Report the exact paired discordance table and two-sided exact McNemar result without treating significance as a gate.
analysis.whole_batch_rule: Do not change the algorithm, prompt, replay semantics, integrity boundary, cases, model, or provider policy until all eight episodes are adjudicated.
analysis.claim_boundary: The result can diagnose repair of a fixed historical-failure stratum. It cannot establish held-out performance, population success, leaderboard rank, generalization, or SOTA.
